data.name: Muniraah
data.long_meaning: Muniraah is derived from the Arabic root 'n-r-r'. It is a beautiful name for a girl, meaning 'Light of the moon'. In Islamic tradition, the moon represents guidance and protection, and the light of the moon is a symbol of Divine guidance and enlightenment.
